_meta.verified_against: 2025 IL-1040 Instructions; 35 ILCS 5/204 (exemption); IL Publication 120; 2025 Schedule M Instructions
_meta.signer: REQUIRED — no named EA/CPA signature yet.
_meta.benchmark: REQUIRED — tie dollar-for-dollar to your actual 2025 IL-1040.
_meta.scope: Step-1: full-year IL resident, W-2 + 1099-INT/DIV/B. No Sch NR, no entity returns.

computation_flow.step2_additions: add IL additions (Sch M) e.g. fed tax-exempt interest from non-US-obligation (Fed 1040 Line 2a)
computation_flow.step3_subtractions: subtract SS + qualified retirement (Line 5), IL overpayment (Line 6), Sch M other (Line 7)
computation_flow.step7_credits: Sch CR (other-state), Sch ICR (property/education), then payments (IL-WIT, IL-1040-ES)

subtractions.social_security_benefits: federally-taxed SS subtracted (IL does not tax)
subtractions.qualified_retirement_income: pensions/401k/IRA/govt retirement subtracted if in federal AGI
subtractions._roth_note: Roth distributions NOT subtracted (already excluded federally)

additions.fed_tax_exempt_interest_dividends: added back except US-obligation interest (Fed 1040 Line 2a)

schedule_m.il_taxed_normally: interest, dividends, capital gains taxed at 4.95% (not subtracted)

computation_notes.p6_1_replacement_tax: replacement_tax added P6.1 (35 ILCS 5/201(c)-(d): 1.5% S-corps and partnerships) - pending dual verification.
computation_notes.p9_1_icr: icr added P9.1 (35 ILCS 5/208 5% property-tax credit; P.A. 100-0022 AGI caps 250k/500k) - pending dual verification.
